Name: SpeakON Agent
Tagline: Turn natural speech into real work for an agent to complete
Description: Turn natural speech into real work with SpeakON Agent. It understands your Notes, connects your tools, and prepares Actions for you to review and confirm.

Name: Knocket AI
Tagline: Chat with visitors from your website or link
Description: Give visitors a way to say hello. Add free live chat to your website or app, or turn your bio link into a personal contact page. Visitors can start chatting without signing up. Built for founders, creators, and small teams.

Name: Vaani Developer Platform
Tagline: The only voice AI harness that you'll ever need
Description: Build a voice agent that sounds and behaves human without writing a single line of code. Design the call flow, handle objections and edge cases, connect your tools and knowledge base, and go live on a real phone number. Every call ends with clean, structured data.

Name: MCP Server by XWiki
Tagline: Give your AI your wiki's knowledge while keeping the control
Description: XWiki MCP Server is an open-source, self-hostable extension that connects XWiki to the AI agent of your choice: OpenCode, Pi, Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and more. You can already use the extension to query your knowledge base to get answers, create and edit pages, and work with structured data directly in XWiki. Try out the extension and let us what's should we improve next!

Name: Nocto
Tagline: Your MacBook notch, finally useful
Description: Nocto turns your MacBook's notch into a small control center. Hover to see what's playing and skip songs. Ten minutes before a call it starts a countdown, and when the meeting begins the notch opens with a Join button (Zoom, Meet, Teams, Webex, FaceTime). Park files on the shelf, find anything you copied in clipboard history, and check your Mac and AirPods battery at a glance. Native, light, macOS 14+. One-time purchase, 7-day free trial. Music stays free forever.

Name: Teable Mobile
Tagline: Build the systems your team runs on, now from your phone
Description: Explain your process like you would to a new hire. Teable builds the database, the app and the automations, so the work stops living in your head. Now you can do it from your phone: hold to talk, publish to your team, and get notified when it's done.

Name: fastbrowse
Tagline: Fastest open source browser agent
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: A fast open-source browser agent. It reads every button, link and field on the page and has a System One model (ex: jev) pick the next step from that list. If it's unsure, it falls back to a standard model model. Fast, cheap, and every answer provides a citation.

Name: SparkBots AI (Powered by Jev)
Tagline: Instantly extract key details and analyze any webpage or PDF
Description: SparkBots can be trained to deeply analyze any web page or PDF. Once trained, your Sparkbot can be run on similar pages returning answers in less than a second. Perfect for analyzing and extracting key details for leads, businesses, resumes, listings, contracts or any PDF. SparkBot use AI, but it isn't a slow LLM like Claude or ChatGPT. It can't hallucinate or make up details that don't exist. Every answer comes straight from the content on the page and anything it doesn't find is left blank.

Name: ilse
Tagline: Point at your app and your AI agent changes the code
Topics: Design Tools, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Ilse puts a toolbar on top of the React app you already have running. Click an element and say what should change, drag to reorder, resize, or tweak spacing and colors with your project's own tokens. Simple tweaks land instantly, with no AI. The rest goes to the agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini), pointing at the right spot in the code. Pro adds test mode: Ilse walks real user journeys on her own and reports what breaks.

Name: Chopstick
Tagline: Mac activity and action widgets that write themselves
Description: Chopstick notices what you repeat on your Mac and builds notch widgets for it, using the coding agent you already have. Your activity log stays local.

Name: iSurge
Tagline: An activity monitor, at your notch.
Description: iSurge is one app for people who live on their Mac: live stats at the notch, each app's volume and mic, disk clean-up, an uninstaller, dev tools for ports, projects and Homebrew, a focus timer and Keep Awake. $14.99 once, $10.99 with PHPROMO20. No account.

Name: Cluinn
Tagline: Answers your questions during the call, not after. For Mac.
Description: Someone asks a question on a call and you need the answer now. Cluinn listens on your Mac and answers mid-call from what was just said, with no bot joining the meeting. Smart Cards flag a question nobody answered. When the call ends you get the action items, and Coach shows how the call went against a goal you set. It also does AI dictation: speak, and clean text lands in any Mac app. For Apple silicon Macs. 14-day trial; LAUNCH30 takes 30% off for 12 months.

Name: Canva Brush
Tagline: Canva Brush: a vision-language model that edits your designs
Description: Canva Brush is a vision-language model for design from Canva Research. It sees your design, understands how it’s put together, and makes the changes you ask for, from one line of copy to every slide in a deck. Everything stays fully editable. Canva says it’s up to 69% faster and 46% lower cost per edit task than its previous design agent. It’s powering Canva AI design edits for Canva Pro subscribers today.

Name: Norah Studio
Tagline: A new space to explore your music
Description: Norah Studio is a creative studio for exploring, transforming and reimagining your music on Mac, iPad and iPhone. Isolate tracks, loop by bars, adjust tempo and key, follow chords, add effects, build harmonies, turn melodies into instruments and export audio or MIDI. Everything runs on your device. Choose a subscription or a one-time purchase; either unlocks Pro on iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account.

Name: Kestrix
Tagline: Repo-agnostic CI control plane with DAG-based triggers.
Description: Kestrix defines CI/CD pipelines in HCL and resolves them into a DAG. A task runs only when the repositories its trigger names have changed. Live task logs in a React Flow UI, and remote runners that only make outbound HTTPS requests.

Name: Faylee
Tagline: Bug reports your coding agent can fix from one link
Topics: Chrome Extensions, Productivity, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Faylee records the screen, console, every network request and each click behind a bug, on one timeline, and shares it all as one link. Your team opens it and sees exactly what broke, with the failing request already open. Paste the link into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, and Faylee's MCP server gives the agent the whole report so it can find the cause and fix it. Instant replay saves the last few minutes after a bug already happened. Free for up to 3 members.

Name: Axonnic
Tagline: Muscle-sensing sleeves for robot training
Description: Axonnic’s forearm sleeve records muscle signals to track finger movement and estimate fingertip force. We combine EMG, video and hand pose into training datasets for robot tasks such as sewing, tool handling and delicate assembly.

Name: StepGrab
Tagline: Now on Windows, with redaction and a real editor
Description: New since our first launch: StepGrab runs on Windows, and projects open on Mac and PC. Black out emails, names or prices, and the box is burned into every export so nobody can lift it off. Every guide opens in an editor: rewrite steps, add arrows, boxes and text, reorder, undo. The direct Mac download uses Accessibility to read the real name of every button you click, so steps get more precise. Still the core: every click becomes a screenshot, arrow and sentence. No account, nothing uploaded.

Name: sitesolide
Tagline: Deploy your vibe-coded apps on your own server
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub, Vibe coding
Description: You built an app with Claude Code or Cursor and want it online. Run sitesolide deploy in its folder and it goes live on your server, on HTTPS, at its own address. Each app is isolated from the others, and you choose who can open it. Free and open source (MIT): you pay for the server and a domain.

Name: StereoLift Live
Tagline: your desktop in real 3D, live on your Quest
Description: Run StereoLift Live on a Windows or Linux PC with an NVIDIA GPU. View your desktop in stereoscopic 3D on Meta Quest over your local network.
